market.question: Will the Kharg Island oil terminal be hit by April 30?

assessment.reasoning: US has conducted strikes on Kharg Island (March 13, April 7) but reports consistently note strikes deliberately AVOIDED oil and gas infrastructure, hitting only military targets. Iranian sources confirm maritime/oil infrastructure suffered little damage and operations continue. With 4 days left and active diplomatic efforts (US-Iran envoys), a deliberate hit on the oil terminal itself is unlikely barring sharp escalation.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Resolution interpretation: 'oil terminal' could be read narrowly (specific facilities) or broadly (any strike on island); collapse of diplomacy could trigger a deliberate infrastructure hit.
